source: api.guildwars2.com /v2/items. Generated by tools/VendorOfferUpdater --build-recipe-sheet-map, which asks the bulk item endpoint about every item ref/vendor_offers.json sells, 200 ids per request. An item is a recipe sheet when details.type is Unlock and details.unlock_type is CraftingRecipe; its details.recipe_id is the recipe it teaches. That is the only place the GW2 API states this link, and no file under ref/ carries it. craftedItemId, disciplines and minRating are read back from ref/recipes_seed.json, and craftedItemName from ref/item_name_seed.json; an entry omits them when the recipe is not in those seeds.
